description: SEC capital-raise and shelf-offering tracker — Is a public company raising money? From SEC EDGAR filings: active shelf registration (S-3/F-3, automatic WKSI shelves) with approximate expiry, primary equity prospectus supplements (424B5 at-the-market / follow-on sales), resale prospectuses (selling-stockholder overhang), S-1/F-1 registrations, S-8 employee-plan registrations, bank note programs detected and excluded, counts by form, the latest filings with links and a verdict NONE / SHELF_ON_FILE / ACTIVELY_RAISING / HEAVY_RAISING. Dilution-risk input for traders and research agents. Params: ticker= (or cik=), months= window 1-60 (default 24). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
